en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Abdullah Bin Suleyman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> (is written): ‘When the eye is blinking, or the feet are kicking, or the tail is moving, and you come over to it, so slaughter it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban ‘Uthman from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sulayman who has said the following: “

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that it is in the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that if the eyes move or the leg runs or the tail moves and you can achieve such opportunity, you then must slaughter it.’”
